title: The Lions Lay Down Quiet
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of the brave start, and tonight Daniel keeps kneeling at his open window when a new rule says not to pray. Bowing his head over his crackers when the kids at the park call praying silly, calm and kind, is exactly Beau’s kind of steady courage.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Daniel kept praying when it was hard, and steady faith is Beau’s strength. In Beau’s world today: some new kids at the park say praying is silly. Beau still bows his head over his crackers, calm and kind, then asks if anybody wants to share. Just like Daniel kneeling to pray three times a day, Beau learned that he never has to hide his love for Heavenly Father.
